classification.difficultyReason: Translate the open solid into five connected rectangles, matching wall dimensions to base edges and omitting the lid.

content.prompt: Sketch an accurate net for this open box.

spec.description: Open rectangular box with its base and interior wall edges visible. The near base edges carry external 5 cm and 4 cm arrows; the right wall carries an external 1 cm height arrow.
spec.mathematics: Five faces: a 5 cm by 4 cm base, two 5 cm by 1 cm walls and two 4 cm by 1 cm walls. No lid. Face paths are explicit; the top is an open rim rather than a filled face.
spec.answerVisibility: All three dimensions and the open top are permanent givens.

answer.short: A $5\text{ cm}\times4\text{ cm}$ base with two $5\text{ cm}\times1\text{ cm}$ walls and two $4\text{ cm}\times1\text{ cm}$ walls; no lid.
answer.worked: Attach a $1\text{ cm}$-wide wall to each edge of the $5\text{ cm}\times4\text{ cm}$ base. Opposite walls are equal. There are five faces because the box is open.

spec.description: One accurate five-face cross-shaped net. Solid lines are cut edges and dashed lines are folds.
spec.mathematics: Central 5 by 4 rectangle; top and bottom 5 by 1 rectangles; left and right 1 by 4 rectangles. Coordinate lengths preserve these proportions.
